Our Services

We offer comprehensive eye care services including exams, contact lens fittings, and treatments for various eye conditions.

tab-2.title: About Us
tab-2.content:
About Dr. Alex Kisitu

Dr. Alex Kisitu is a certified eye care specialist with over 15 years of experience in ophthalmology and optometry.

team.name: Dr. Alex Kisitu
team.bio: Dr. Kisitu graduated from the University of Medical Sciences with honors and has been practicing for over 15 years. He specializes in pediatric eye care and refractive surgery.

team.name: Dr. Sarah Johnson
team.bio: Dr. Johnson joined our practice in 2019 and has expertise in contact lens fitting and management of dry eye conditions.

privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.content:
Privacy Policy

Your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you visit our website or use our services.

We collect information such as your name, contact details, and health information necessary to provide eye care services. This information is kept secure and confidential.
